wistram_academy.name: Wistram Academy

canon_ref.note: Kent Scott says only Wistram could cast a spell that reaches across the world. Pisces and Ceria studied there (2.04).

wistram_academy.summary: The isle of mages. Its mages link stranded Earthers through their phones in a costly spell, and a gathering of great mages there ranks the world's likeliest disasters.

invrisil.name: Invrisil

canon_ref.note: Fals: three hundred miles north of Celum. That Magnolia's winter home (2.06) is in Invrisil is likely, not stated.

invrisil.summary: The city of adventurers, far north of Celum. Magnolia Reinhart winters there and travels to it in a horseless magic carriage.

tailless_thief.name: The Tailless Thief
tailless_thief.summary: The most famous and most expensive inn in Liscor, on the north side. Busy from morning, with bright lamps and Drake barmaids; almost all its guests are well-off Drakes.

stitchworks.name: Stitchworks
stitchworks.summary: Octavia's potion shop on a side street of Celum: herbs on the beams, potions on the walls, a safety lamp, and boards where the display glass should be.
